description: Meet the man behind the fight to save delta farm jobs. INDIANOLA - So, just who is this man who's made the plight of farm workers in the Mississippi Delta, his life's work? Ty Pinkins makes a great first impression, and people say, the more you talk to him, the more you realize how deep his passion runs.“I went to law school with the desire to get a law degree and come back to the Mississippi Delta and work in low income communities . . ."Read more

title: Who is Ty Pinkins?
